d: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

An emotionally-engaging, heartbreaking family drama with a dystopian sci-fi twist, starring Julie Delpy (Before Sunrise), Richard Armitage (The Stranger), Gemma Arterton (Summerland) and Daniel Brhl (Captain America: Civil War). Top-level scientist Isabelle is forced to stay in contact with her ex as they are co-parent their daughter and when tragedy strikes she takes matters into her own hands.

After four years of chasing his stand-up comedy dream in Los Angeles, 34-year old Scott Rollins has crashed and burned. On a night out, Scott strikes up an unlikely friendship with an eccentric dermatologist, Marty. As their relationship evolves, they realise they need to find the strength to start confronting their long-simmering regrets.

A heart-wrenching tale of finding love in the least-likely of places. Starring Academy Award nominee Elliot Page (The Umbrella Academy) and Kate Mara (TVs House of Cards). Two women from opposite sides of fierce protests meet on the picket lines and form an unlikely friendship. While dealing with their respective issues they grow ever closer, leading to a life changing romance.
